problem: Cold weight source parsing, codec binding and imports were compiled inside the same Qwen main TU as request/model execution. Existing ProjectionBinding declarations did not isolate their implementation.
change: Qwen-private weights.h/weights.cc hold original Tensor/LoadedWeight and cold projection/source APIs. Recipe keeps the same typed ProjectionBinding and original stable map nodes. Model, Session, request/CLI and numerical Graph paths are unchanged. No new owner, IR, registry, virtual layer or loader policy.

source_equivalence.facts: GraphAssembly/Recipe/sampling/ledger middle and the complete Model/Session/request/CLI suffix are byte-identical. Projection and loader bodies retain original semantics. Tensor storage/move/read/write/view/dump remain inline; only cold Backend-dependent freeze moves out of line.

build_boundary: The same weights.cc is compiled by each actual engine/probe/lifecycle/Vulkan-retirement consumer under its own existing HYLE_COMPUTE_* capability definitions. No cross-capability Backend object/static library is shared and no public CMake option is added.

actual_CPU.fixture: Original cached untrained A/H64/FFN128/V64 fixture; actual Model/Session logits helper, not a trained Qwen2B model or quality run.
actual_CPU.dependency_separation: Actual weights dependencies contain no main.cc/helper. Actual thin consumer no longer parses fp8_weight_import.h or nf4_weight_import.h.

engineering.limits: Existing no-SDK component/target CMake checks; not a complete native build matrix.

first_environment_failure: The first engineering-test process inherited the narrow native runtime PATH and could not locate cmake.exe (WinError2). Original command/stdout/stderr/process are retained under engine-components. Adding existing CMake to that test PATH made its eight tests pass under engine-components2. No C++ compile, link or Model inference was repeated for this correction.

independent_review.scope: Independent source/ownership/numerical/CMake review by mtp_performance_audit; its source-only finding is separate from the actual CPU check.

limits: No GPU, new backend/codec numerical matrix, original publisher payload or trained-model quality qualification.
Compile durations are recorded process facts, not a performance benchmark or TPS/speedup claim.
Existing manual non-CMake probes/future thin drivers must link weights.cc using their own original capability macros; historical frozen recipes are retained as historical evidence.
